shorts_rules: State the topic clearly within the first 3 seconds to avoid early drop-off.
Keep total video length strictly between 20-25 seconds for news updates and 30-35 seconds for big questions.
Make numbers feelable by linking them immediately to a concrete, visual scale instead of just quoting raw statistics.
Use a counter-intuitive hook or striking visual question in the opening line to drive initial engagement.
Structure the narrative as a clear step-by-step evolution from a problem to an unexpected technical solution.
End every Short with a fresh, natural sign-off mentioning Tomorrowly instead of repetitive catchphrases.
Avoid complex multi-clause sentences in the first 7 seconds where drop-off rates are historically highest.
Prompt viewer interaction with a targeted, specific question at the end rather than a generic subscribe plea.
visual_sound_notes: Synchronize 3D animations and stock footage precisely word-for-word with the voice-over narration.
Use medium-sized captions with 2-5 words at a time, highlighting critical keywords in yellow or red.
Maintain an average cut rate of 2.0 to 3.5 cuts per 10 seconds to sustain visual momentum without inducing fatigue.
Mix cinematic or upbeat background music moderately below the clear voice-over, punctuated by subtle sound effects.
summary_roman_urdu: Is mahine viral hone wali videos mein strong visual shocks, counter-intuitive hooks, aur clear step-by-step explanations ka pattern sab se zyada chal raha hai. Hamare apne analytics yeh dikhate hain ki viewers shuru ke 5 se 8 seconds mein drop ho rahe hain agar topic ya hook mein thodi bhi confusion ho. Humein apni shuruat ki lines ko aur zyada sharp aur simple rakhna hoga bina lambe complex sentences ke. Is ke ilawa, aakhri sign-off mein Tomorrowly ka naam alag aur fresh andaz mein use karna zaroori hai taake audience bore na ho. Visuals aur 3D animations ki synchronization ko mazeed behtar banakar hum apne watch percentage ko aur upar le ja sakte hain.
